title: Signed certification result bundle and lifecycle record v1
description: One signed record of one conformance run against one exact compatibility tuple, plus the lifecycle state that run produced. docs/integrations/ADAPTER_CERTIFICATION_POLICY.md is the normative owner; packages/schemas/planning-schema.sql#certification_results and #source_certifications are the persistence owners; the source-certification machine owns the lifecycle. A result is append-only and immutable: a later run is a new record and never an edit, because the appraisal of a claim accepted under an earlier result has to stay reproducible. A registry may advertise support only for a certification in the active state, so nothing here can imply exercised support for a tuple that is planned, testing, expired, suspended, superseded or retired.

tuple_digest.description: The digest of the packages/schemas/compatibility-tuple-v1.schema.json record this certification covers. It is the join key between a claim, its appraisal and this record.

effective_ceiling.description: The strongest evidence class a claim under this tuple may reach. Only an active certification may exceed private-analytics; the DDL carries the pairing as a check constraint, so an expired or suspended tuple cannot sit beside a hardened ceiling even by mistake.

valid_until.description: A certification expires rather than lasting until somebody notices. An expired tuple drops to private-analytics and stops being advertised, which is the difference between a registry that says what has been exercised and one that says what was exercised once.

suite_manifest_sha256.description: The D-242 manifest that ran, bound by digest so a result cannot claim a pass against a suite whose cases moved afterwards.

negative_case_count.description: Counted separately, and required to be non-zero on a pass. A suite with no negative case has not demonstrated that it can fail, so its pass carries no information — which is the same reasoning D-242 applies at the manifest level.

cose_sign1_b64.description: COSE_Sign1 over the result digest, algorithm -19 Ed25519 under D-190, with the deterministic encoding D-191 fixes.

case_id.description: Permanent and never reused, under D-242.

clause.description: The specific clause the case enforces, as D-242 requires. A case that cannot name one is testing something nobody wrote down.
